## FileRecurringJournalStore

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.FinancialOperations.FundAdministration.FileRecurringJournalStore</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/FundAdministration/FileRecurringJournalStore.cs:14](../../../../src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/FundAdministration/FileRecurringJournalStore.cs#L14).

Durable recurring definitions and claims. All processes sharing this directory serialize their entire intake cycle using an OS-exclusive lease, not an instance-only semaphore. The snapshot is flushed before atomic replacement. Missing/corrupt state never becomes empty state.

## FundAdministrationControlService

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.FinancialOperations.FundAdministration.FundAdministrationControlService</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/FundAdministration/FundAdministrationControlService.cs:22](../../../../src/Meridian.FinancialOperations/FundAdministration/FundAdministrationControlService.cs#L22).

FundStudio-style administration control surface. Drives organization/entity/portfolio/account/book/ period/report administration by composing the ledger-domain primitives — multi-book locked periods with evidence-bearing reopen, journal templates, recurring journals, year-end close, and portfolio-specific pricing rules — and recording every privileged action into a tamper-evident, append-only FundAdministrationEventLog.

Prepares a reviewed factor paydown from the lots of record: loads the lots open in the scope as of the effective date, derives held face and the position principal through the registered projector, allocates principal and pro-rata basis relief per lot, and assembles the canonical corporate-action event, lineage, two- or three-line projected effect and lot instruction the spine retains. It never approves or posts; the candidate service and the atomic store re-derive and re-lock everything here before anything is written. Hosts compose it like the amortization preview: a host without persistence still starts, and preparation refuses the missing authority before reading any source record.
